items.definition:
someone who pushes; a drug dealer
The police arrested a drug pusher in the alley.

a device or substance for separating things
A comma often acts as a separator in a list.

a large, heavy hammer
He used a sledgehammer to break down the old wall.

a large landmass smaller than a continent
India is often referred to as a subcontinent.

an electrical station
The power outage was caused by a fault at the local substation.

a thing of little value or importance
Don't worry about it; it's just a mere trifle.

evil; moral badness
The story explored the depths of human wickedness.

the main artery of the body
Blood is pumped from the heart into the aorta.

American Standard Code for Information Interchange
The text file was saved in ASCII format.

a spiritual hermitage or monastery in Indian religions
She spent a month at an ashram in India, practicing yoga and meditation.

a score of one stroke over par on a hole in golf; an imaginary evil creature
He scored a bogey on the third hole.

a chemical element with the symbol B and atomic number 5
Boron is used in the manufacture of glass and ceramics.

Bisphenol A (a chemical used in plastics)
Many plastic bottles are now advertised as BPA-free.

inflammation of the lining of the bronchial tubes
He developed acute bronchitis after a severe cold.

A brass instrument similar to a trumpet.
The soldier played a bugle call at dawn.

The relationship between cause and effect.
Scientists are studying the causality between diet and disease.

The part of a bell that strikes the side to make a sound.
The bell's clapper swung back and forth, ringing loudly.

A high-quality brandy, originally produced in Cognac, France.
He enjoyed a glass of fine cognac after dinner.

The action of hiding something or preventing it from being known.
The police investigated the concealment of evidence.

A person or company that builds something; in programming, a special method for creating an object.
The software constructor helps to initialize new objects.

Credibility or street credibility.
His long history in the music industry gave him a lot of cred.

minor crime
The program aims to reduce juvenile delinquency.

harmful act
It would be a great disservice to ignore their contributions.

dislike
She expressed her distaste for the new policy.

act of erasing
The erasure of data from the hard drive was complete.

making easier
The facilitation of communication is key to teamwork.

lie
The politician was accused of spreading falsehoods.

projecting rim
The pipe had a flange for connecting to another section.

type of biscuit
She enjoyed a cup of tea with a Florentine biscuit.

ownership of land for an unlimited period
They purchased the freehold of the property.

a port where goods can be imported duty-free
The city established a freeport to boost trade.

Free Trade Agreement
The two countries signed a new FTA.

the measurement around something
The tree had an impressive girth.

the office or period of being a governor
She announced her candidacy for the governorship.

a device for measuring time using sand
The sand slowly trickled through the hourglass.

extreme foolishness or stupidity
His decision was an act of pure idiocy.

a device used to administer medication in the form of a mist or powder, inhaled into the lungs
She always carries her inhaler for her asthma.

the quality of being intricate or complex
The intricacy of the clockwork mechanism was astonishing.

a liquid made of shellac dissolved in alcohol, or of synthetic substances, that dries to form a hard, protective coating for wood, metal, etc.
The antique table was restored with a fresh coat of lacquer.

a region characterized by many lakes
The Lakeland region is famous for its beautiful scenery and hiking trails.

a class given to students of a particular discipline by an expert
The renowned chef gave a masterclass on French pastry techniques.

the state or ceremony of being married; marriage
They entered into holy matrimony after a long courtship.

an expert in meteorology; a weather forecaster
The meteorologist predicted heavy rainfall for the weekend.

an area planted with explosive mines; a situation or subject presenting hidden dangers or difficulties
Navigating the legal system can be a minefield for those without experience.

a soft, low, and indistinct sound
She heard a soft murmur of voices from the next room.

an implicit or unspoken quality or feeling associated with something
His comments had an overtone of sarcasm.

a player who controls the flow of the team's offensive play
The team's new midfielder is a brilliant playmaker.

a substance that propels something, especially a rocket or missile
The rocket uses solid propellant for its initial thrust.

a person who lives a solitary life and tends to avoid other people
The old man lived as a recluse in the mountains.

a course or lesson that serves to refresh one's memory or skills
I need to take a refresher course in first aid.

an effect that simulates the sound of a reverberating space
The singer added some reverb to her vocals for a fuller sound.

A tube used to transfer liquid from one container to another
He used a siphon to drain the fuel from the tank.

A person or thing that slashes; a type of horror film
The film was a classic slasher movie.

A person ideally suited to another as a close friend or romantic partner
Many people hope to find their soulmate.

A sharp, pointed organ of an insect or animal that can inject venom; a sharp remark
The bee left its stinger in his arm.

A horse bred or trained for trotting races; a person who trots
The trotter moved gracefully around the track.

the quality of being strange or unusual
The weirdness of the situation made everyone uncomfortable.

a person in charge of horses or cattle; a type of Jeep
The cowboy was an expert horse wrangler.

a scrape or rub mark
He had a minor abrasion on his knee after the fall.

a person suffering from celiac disease; celiac disease
As a celiac, she has to be very careful about what she eats to avoid gluten.

a foolish or easily deceived person
Don't be a chump and fall for that old trick again.

a factor that decisively affects the nature or outcome of something
Hard work is a key determinant of success.

reduction in the value of a currency
The government announced a devaluation of the national currency.

the part of the alimentary canal that connects the throat to the stomach
Food passes down the esophagus to the stomach.
